title: A chain's link and next step run although the parent's result could not be stored, beside the errback, and the next step's FAILURE turns into SUCCESS
where: related to celery issue 10954 (the same window, reached by a lost pool child); not yet in the tracker
thread: a reply on celery issue 10954 (drafted by the lead)
observed: 768e476 with kombu 445027e, a real prefork worker on Redis: a returns a value the serializer cannot encode: 5 of 5 runs ran the link and the errback, and b was read PENDING, FAILURE, then SUCCESS (lead: 3 of 3 on main 9c2f238). Mode operational, a backend that raises kombu OperationalError on a's SUCCESS write: 3 of 3, the same, nothing redelivered.
